title: docs(spec): record-surface docblocks name editMode and the per-flow derivation
body:
Fixes #23964

Clause-②: no

## What

Docblock text only in `packages/spec/src/data/record-surface.ts`, plus one `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`. No code, no `.zod.ts`, no ADR, no objectui file.

1. **`deriveRecordFlowSurface` docblock (shipped in `dist/data/index.d.ts`).** It called its override list "the sanctioned per-object overrides — no new authorable key", but the same package declares `ObjectSchema.editMode` (`object.zod.ts`, admitted by commit f11fc61c5's maintainer ruling) and the renderer applies it. The sentence now says what the function reads (`def.fields`, `flow`, `opts`, nothing else) and lists only the explicit config the console renderer applies over the default: `navigation.mode` / `navigation.size`, an assigned page, and `editMode`. `FormView.type` / `modalSize` are no longer listed: measured at the objectui pin f8267df9, an authored `FormView.modalSize` does not reach the create/edit modal, and `FormView.type` changes only its layout. It says plainly that the function does not read `editMode`.
2. **File header (not shipped).** It said create/edit/detail opens "a full page, or an overlay" and "field-heavy → full page; otherwise a side drawer", which is the base derivation only. It now gives the per-flow result the code returns: view → routed page when field-heavy or on mobile, otherwise a drawer; create/edit → always an overlay, a modal when field-heavy or on mobile (full-screen on mobile, bounded on desktop), otherwise a drawer. The "explicit control is an assigned page" sentence now names a view's navigation config, an assigned page and `editMode`.

## Measured

- **What the derivation reads.** `deriveRecordSurface` reads `def.fields` (via `countAuthorableFields`), `opts.viewport` and `opts.pageThreshold`. `deriveRecordFlowSurface` adds `flow`. Neither reads `navigation.*`, `FormView.*`, an assigned page or `editMode`. The renderer applies those over the default, except `FormView.modalSize`: at the objectui pin f8267df9, the console's create/edit modal fixes `formType: 'modal'` (`AppContent.tsx` :1179) and takes `modalSize` only from this derivation's `'full'`, and `resolveFormViewLayout` (`recordFormNavigation.ts` :197-:218) copies no `modalSize`. So an authored `FormView.modalSize` does not reach that surface, and the docblock no longer says the renderer lets it win. So the dispatch's first hypothesis ("the overrides the derivation itself defers to") is slightly off: the code does not defer to any of them. The new text says "the renderer lets explicit config win over it" and does not claim the function reads any of them.
- **What ships.** After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, the new sentence ("not read here") is in `dist/data/index.d.ts` and `dist/data/index.d.mts`. Positive control: `deriveRecordFlowSurface` is in `dist/data/index.d.ts`. The header's new heading text ("derivation, not an authored object key") has 0 hits in `dist`, so the header does not ship. `files[]` ships `dist`. `src/**/*.zod.ts` does not cover this `.ts`. So a `patch` changeset is owed.
- **Generated outputs.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exits 0: all 14 artifacts are up to date. Nothing was regenerated.

## Verification (head 491bf57)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data/record-surface.test.ts`: 15 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 78 families. All of them were run locally with exit codes recorded. `--ran` reports 77 run and 1 NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) because the workspace is not fully built here; CI runs it. Three first runs exited 3 for missing prerequisites (a shallow-clone fixture commit and unbuilt `formula` / `lint` / `objectql`). After fetching and building those prerequisites, all three were re-run and exited 0.

## Acceptance notes

- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (comment-only).
- Left out of scope, as the card says: whether the derivation itself should read `editMode`, and objectui's console ignoring the derived task-flow surface.
